entities.summary: Sada Mire is a Swedish-Somali archaeologist, and public intellectual known for her work on the archaeology and heritage of the Horn of Africa. She is Associate Professor of Heritage Studies at the University College London Institute of Archaeology and founder of the [Horn Heritage Foundation], a non-profit organization dedicated to preserving cultural heritage in the region.
